key_insight: fix(compass): port generic project scanner to programmatic API
outcome:
Commit `636613f` missed the squash-merge of PR #31 — this PR brings it in.

## What was missing

`modules/compass/sources/index.ts` and `modules/compass/behavior.ts` still had the same quorum-specific hardcodings as the original CLI. Any AI agent (Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini, Codex) calling `createCompass().mapBehaviors()` got a map of quorum's own features rather than the host project.

## Changes

**sources/index.ts**
- `docsSource`: scan all root `.md` files + `docs/documentation/doc/.github
